DateRange.description: Inclusive date range. The layer works in whole days; sub-daily is out of scope.
DateRange.title: DateRange

IndicatorId.description:
Every quantity the layer can serve.

Grouped by family; the family is derivable via :func:`indicator_family`.
IndicatorId.title: IndicatorId

ProvenanceStep.description:
One link in the chain.

The six fields the build prompt calls non-negotiable for an ingested record — source,
dataset id, acquisition time, processing time, pipeline version, spatial reference —
are all here. They are optional only where the step kind makes them meaningless: a
validation step has no acquisition timestamp of its own, it inherits the one carried by
the observation steps beneath it.

access_route.description: How the data was reached, e.g. 'earth-search-v1' or 'open-meteo-archive'. Distinguishes the dataset from the intermediary that served it.
access_route.title: Access Route

acquired_at.description: When the underlying observation was made.
acquired_at.title: Acquired At

asset_ids.description: Scene, granule or asset identifiers consumed by this step.
asset_ids.title: Asset Ids

description.description: Plain-language account of what this step did.
description.title: Description

parameters.description: Every parameter that affects the numeric output of this step.
parameters.title: Parameters

software.description: Library and version doing the work, e.g. 'rasterio 1.4.3'.
software.title: Software

spatial_ref.description: CRS of this step's output, as an authority code, e.g. 'EPSG:32610'.
spatial_ref.title: Spatial Ref

ProvenanceStep.title: ProvenanceStep

StepKind.description:
What a provenance step represents.

A well-formed chain starts with at least one ``observation`` and ends with a
``validation``. Everything between is ``processing``.
StepKind.title: StepKind

ValidationFlag.description:
A constraint the value did not satisfy.

Flags travel with the value rather than replacing it. A consumer that ignores flags
gets a number; a consumer that reads them gets a number and the reason to discount it.

confidence_penalty.description: Multiplicative reduction this flag applied to the confidence score.
confidence_penalty.title: Confidence Penalty

constraint.description: Identifier of the constraint that produced this flag.
constraint.title: Constraint

expected.description: What the constraint required, in plain language.
expected.title: Expected

observed.description: The value that tripped the check.
observed.title: Observed

ValidationFlag.title: ValidationFlag

description:
A value the constraint engine refused.

Deliberately has no ``value`` field. A rejected measurement is reported as an absence
with a reason, never as a number the caller might use by accident.

provenance.description: Ordered chain from source observation to validated output. Never empty — a value without provenance cannot be constructed.
provenance.title: Provenance
